'''Open (40 cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>open40card</code>). It uses the same card pool as [[Open]], with a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp" /> On play.swccg.com it is no longer a separate format. Since 3 November 2026, a table, league or tournament there plays [[Open]] with the deck size game option set to 40 cards, and the old code still loads that way.<ref name="gemp-setup">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/e0fb37f23b6d81b7a3a248127d78466601cb6be4/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit e0fb37f2), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261103212934/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/e0fb37f2/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp-options">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/e0fb37f23b6d81b7a3a248127d78466601cb6be4/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/setup/GameOptions.java GameOptions.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit e0fb37f2), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261103212856/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/e0fb37f2/GameOptions.java.html Internet Archive].</ref> The card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112. It also includes current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301).<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 40 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

On play.swccg.com, deck size is a game option chosen when a table, league or tournament is set up, separate from the format. Any format can be played at any supported size (40 to 100 cards as of November 2026). Games show the chosen size next to the format name, for example "Open · 40 cards".<ref name="gemp-options" /><ref name="gemp-setup" />
